stories.title: Man who killed pastor in Maryville denied request to leave mental health center
stories.summary: A circuit judge denied the request from Terry J. Sedlaceck to leave the center on a supervised group trip.

stories.title: Public voices concern over Ameren's proposed natural gas plant near Sioux coal facility
stories.summary: Ameren Missouri's plan for a new natural gas power plant has sparked public concern in St. Charles County, with residents and officials questioning its necessity.

stories.title: St. Charles approves land sale for $200 million riverfront project with indoor beach
stories.summary: The City Council voted 10-0 to approve the sale. Developers said construction on the year-round lagoon beach and luxury condos could begin in early 2027.

stories.title: Charges filed after man shot in front of 4-year-old grandson at Florissant QuikTrip
stories.summary: The victim's 4-year-old grandson was inside the car near his grandfather when the shooting occurred but was uninjured.

stories.title: St. Louis can't say for sure which data centers have a license. It would like to tax them anyway.
stories.summary: The license collector stood by a slide naming seven companies. She now says she didn't run the search and is checking with their lawyers.

stories.title: Lawsuit seeks to block Missouri restrictions on SNAP purchases of soda, candy
stories.summary: A class action lawsuit seeks to strike down restrictions for SNAP recipients on products such as candy and soda in 18 states.

stories.title: Court to eye potential adult trial in shooting death of 16-Year-Old Jefferson County girl
stories.summary: Four months after Gabbriana Boyster was found dead inside her Hillsboro home, the case heads back to court next week.

stories.title: St. Louis police board redoes chief's contract amid Sunshine probe, as mayor says the outside offer never materialized
stories.summary: Chief Robert Tracy keeps his $295,000 salary but loses a $24,500 retirement payment. The police union says the board's priorities are still wrong.

stories.title: Report: St. Louis rent increased 3.2% last year
stories.summary: A report from Realtor.com revealed that despite the region's large apartment pipeline, rents are growing in other Midwest metros, including Chicago and Minneapolis.

stories.title: 2 assaults reported at St. Louis City Justice Center, police say
stories.summary: The first fight was reported around 11 a.m. on Monday, while the second altercation happened just 30 minutes later.

stories.title: Restaurant taking over former Canyon Cafe space
stories.summary: Canyon Cafe closed in January after operating there for more than 15 years.

stories.title: Man receives 45 years in prison for 2016 shooting that left Ballwin police officer paralyzed
stories.summary: Antonio Taylor, 42, was sentenced to 45 years in the Missouri Department of Corrections in a plea agreement with prosecutors.
